All original conditions are retained: 2 <= n <= 6; (N^(n+1),g) compact Riemannian manifold with boundary; fixed Lambda, mu >= 0 and integer p >= 1; smooth connected strongly properly embedded free-boundary minimal M_k with area H^n(M_k) <= Lambda and lambda_p(M_k) >= -mu. The limit is smooth connected compact embedded minimal, orthogonal meeting along its own boundary, and may have improper contact. No assumption (P), mean convexity, index-one restriction or guaranteed proper limit is added; final membership holds only if M belongs to the original class M.
